title: Semen and Sperm
summary: Semen is the fluid that comes out during ejaculation; sperm are the microscopic cells in it that can fertilise an egg. Most of the volume is fluid from the prostate and seminal vesicles.
key_points: Sperm can survive inside the body for up to about five days.
Semen can carry STIs, including HIV.
